title: Repository Management

use_cases.name: Register Repository Type
use_cases.description: Developer registers a PHP class for a given repository type string via setRepositoryClass(type, class).
use_cases.notes: Stores mapping in $repositoryClasses[] keyed by type string (e.g. 'composer', 'vcs', 'path').

use_cases.name: Create Repository Instance
use_cases.description: Developer requests a new repository instance of a registered type with config; RepositoryManager instantiates the class and optionally wraps it in FilterRepository.
use_cases.notes: Throws InvalidArgumentException if type not registered. Wraps result in FilterRepository if config has 'only', 'exclude', or 'canonical' keys.

use_cases.name: Add Repository to Chain
use_cases.description: Developer appends a repository instance to the managed list for package resolution.

use_cases.name: Prepend Repository to Chain
use_cases.description: A plugin injects a repository at the beginning of the chain so it takes precedence over Packagist.
use_cases.notes: Uses array_unshift so the injected repo is checked first during package resolution.

use_cases.name: Set Local (Installed) Repository
use_cases.description: Developer sets the local installed-packages repository.
use_cases.notes: Stored separately from the remote $repositories list.

use_cases.name: Get Local Repository
use_cases.description: Developer retrieves the local installed-packages repository.

use_cases.name: List All Repositories
use_cases.description: Developer retrieves all registered remote repositories.
use_cases.notes: Returns remote repos only; local repository is excluded.

use_cases.name: Find Package Across Repositories
use_cases.description: Developer searches for a single package by name+constraint across all managed repositories.
use_cases.notes: Iterates repositories in order; returns first match.

use_cases.name: Find All Matching Packages
use_cases.description: Developer searches for all packages matching name+constraint across all managed repositories.
use_cases.notes: Aggregates results from all repositories via array_merge.

use_cases.name: Configure Composer (HTTP) Repository
use_cases.description: Developer configures a Packagist/HTTP repository with URL, options, caching, and notification settings.
use_cases.notes: ComposerRepository extends ArrayRepository; implements ConfigurableRepositoryInterface, AdvisoryProviderInterface, FilterListProviderInterface. Requires url in repoConfig.

use_cases.name: Configure VCS Repository
use_cases.description: Developer configures a VCS (git/svn/hg) repository with a URL; RepositoryManager resolves the correct VcsDriver.
use_cases.notes: VcsRepository extends ArrayRepository; implements ConfigurableRepositoryInterface. Uses VcsDriverInterface implementations.

use_cases.name: Apply Repository Filter
use_cases.description: RepositoryManager wraps a created repository in a FilterRepository when 'only', 'exclude', or 'canonical' filter config keys are present.
use_cases.notes: FilterRepository implements RepositoryInterface; delegates to inner repo, applying allow/deny package name filters.

key_relationships: RepositoryManager creates RepositoryInterface via registered repositoryClasses map
ComposerRepository extends ArrayRepository implements ConfigurableRepositoryInterface, AdvisoryProviderInterface, FilterListProviderInterface
include_extend_notes: UC2 (Create Repository) includes UC12 (Apply Filter) when filter keys present
UC3 (Add Repository) and UC4 (Prepend Repository) are variations of the same goal — UC4 extends UC3 for plugin override scenario
UC8 (Find Package) and UC9 (Find All Packages) share the same repository iteration logic
important_notes: RepositoryManager is the central facade. Repository types must be registered via setRepositoryClass before createRepository can be called — this is done during Composer bootstrap. FilterRepository is a decorator, not a first-class registered type. The 'local repository' (InstalledRepository) tracks what is already installed; the remote $repositories list is queried for resolution.
